trust_decision.summary: Whether a client verifies the control plane's TLS certificate: at the pinned commit an empty CA setting is treated as 'skip verification' instead of 'use system roots'; verification may only be disabled by an explicit opt-in.

landing_point.why: Summary names kumactl; kumactl's API client calls util_http.ConfigureMTLS (app/kumactl/pkg/client/api_server_client.go:26), whose empty-CA branch sets InsecureSkipVerify.

fix_sites.entry_point: every kumactl command that talks to the API server via ApiServerClient (app/kumactl/pkg/client/api_server_client.go:15-26), incl. config control-planes add validation (app/kumactl/pkg/config/validate.go:15-16)
kumactl config control-planes add --skip-verify (flag declared at :97 but never stored)
kuma-dp run bootstrap fetch over https
kuma-cp inter-CP gRPC client (grpcs) via pkg/intercp/components.go:102-103
fix_sites.module_kind: internal server-to-server client (looks out of scope for a kumactl advisory)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: app/kuma-dp/pkg/dataplane/envoy/remote_bootstrap.go:66-75 (separate TLS setup in kuma-dp, not via ConfigureMTLS); also pkg/intercp/client/client.go:47-49

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Advisory says kumactl; kuma-dp's empty-CA branch logs an explicit [WARNING] and carries a '#nosec -- we have the warning above' comment (remote_bootstrap.go:73-74), so it reads as intentional documented behaviour; the intercp nil-TLS branch is unreachable via the Pool, which refuses nil TLS (pkg/intercp/client/pool.go:54-55).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: HTTPS to a CP with a publicly trusted cert and no --ca-cert-file must keep working through system roots, and an explicit skip-verify opt-in must still disable verification (e2e runs kuma-dp with --skip-verify, fix.diff:241). A fix that rejects https without a CA, or that drops the opt-in, breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: kumactl CA file set (path read from disk)
kumactl skip_verify persisted in config file and reloaded
kuma-dp CA as inline PEM (KUMA_CONTROL_PLANE_CA_CERT) or file (--ca-cert-file, folded into CaCert at app/kuma-dp/cmd/run.go:236-241)
intercp grpcs with nil TLS config

O7_producer.where: pkg/config/app/kumactl/v1alpha1/config.proto:59 (ApiServer message lacks skip_verify), saved/loaded by app/kumactl/pkg/config/io.go:16,35

O8b_injection_room.sibling: kuma-dp exporter TLS config that sets InsecureSkipVerify when no Certificate is given
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same 'empty CA => skip' idiom the project already used in two other kuma-dp/kumactl clients; a maintainer copying remote_bootstrap.go would write it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: zone-to-global KDS client treating empty RootCAFile as skip-verify instead of using the explicit TlsSkipVerify flag
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Function already takes rootCaFile and skipVerify side by side; collapsing them is a plausible 'simplification', and it sits in another package far from the kumactl landing point.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: bootstrap response's xDS trustedCa (pkg/xds/bootstrap/template_v3.go:207-210) could be made to depend on a CA returned by the CP over the unverified bootstrap channel
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Envoy's xDS trust is already derived from the bootstrap request's CaCert (pkg/xds/bootstrap/generator.go:393-411); a how-type cross-boundary producer.

O9_family: improper certificate validation (CWE-295), insecure TLS default when CA unset

O10_build.toolchain: Go toolchain per go.mod; protoc/protoc-gen-go only if regenerating config.pb.go (hand-editing generated descriptor is error-prone)
O10_build.project_tests: Ginkgo tests: app/kumactl/cmd/config/config_control_planes_add_test.go, pkg/api-server/auth_test.go (calls ConfigureMTLS), app/kuma-dp/pkg/dataplane/envoy remote bootstrap tests, pkg/config/app/kuma-dp golden config (pkg/config/app/kuma-dp/testdata/default-config.golden.yaml)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Delete the InsecureSkipVerify branch in pkg/util/http/tls.go only, leaving kumactl's existing --skip-verify flag unpersisted (no proto field) and kuma-dp/intercp untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: app/kuma-dp/pkg/dataplane/probes/http.go:121-122 skips verification for app probes to the local workload; that is a different trust relationship, not the CP.
